# Rescale Vector to Arbitrary Minimum and Maximum

`make_scale()` will rescale any vector to have a user-defined minimum
and maximum.

## Usage

``` r
make_scale(x, minim, maxim)
```

## Arguments

- x:

  a numeric vector

- minim:

  a desired numeric minimum

- maxim:

  a desired numeric maximum

## Value

The function takes a numeric vector and returns a rescaled version of it
with the observed (desired) minimum, the observed (desired) maximum, and
rescaled values between both extremes.

## Details

This function is useful if you wanted to do some kind of minimum-maximum
rescaling of a variable on some given scale, prominently rescaling to a
minimum of 0 and a maximum of 1 (thinking ahead to a regression). The
function is flexible enough for any minimum or maximum.

## Examples

``` r

x <- runif(100, 1, 100)
make_scale(x, 2, 5) # works
```
